title: The bell changes shape
hook: A soft body can push water.

knows: Animals can have structures and life stages that differ from humans.
doesNotKnow: The broad bell and then the contracted bell illustrate part of a swimming pulse; the arrows indicate water pushed away. Jellyfish locomotion differs among species, and this is a schematic rather than a simulation of fluid flow.

misconception: The observations in this scenario require a different interpretation.
objective: In a simplified jellyfish swimming pulse, what does contraction of the bell push away?
